newsitem.title: GERMANY: Kohl congratulates Netanyahu, Arafat on Hebron deal.
newsitem.headline: Kohl congratulates Netanyahu, Arafat on Hebron deal.

text.p: German Chancellor Helmut Kohl sent a telegram to Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Palestinian President Yasser Arafat on Wednesday welcoming a deal to extend Palestinian rule to Hebron in the West Bank.

"I very much welcome the agreement which is of very special importance for both sides," Kohl said in a letter which addressed both Netanyahu and Arafat as "dear friend". Kohl said he hoped the accord would unblock the Middle East peace process.
"I see this as an important step for the continuation of the peace process on the basis of the existing agreement," Kohl said.
Israel's cabinet and the Palestinian Authority will meet separately later on Wednesday to approve a deal initialled by negotiators at a late-night summit between Netanyaho and Arafat.
Kohl said he hoped the breakthrough could be used to increase the trust between the two sides and give the peace process a new dynamic.
